ValidationRule.description: This will fire when any of the 3 fields are entered, but not when all three are blank. If at least one is filled in, all three must be. CRM-4364
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR ( ISBLANK(TEXT(LGD_Rating__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(PD_Rating__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(BRR_Scorecard_Used__c)) ), NOT( AND(ISBLANK(TEXT(LGD_Rating__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(PD_Rating__c)), ISBLANK(TEXT(BRR_Scorecard_Used__c)) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: PD Rating, LGD Rating and BRR Scorecard Used must have a value before saving.
